title: MEDITA: a Multimodal hEalth Data lakehouse for ITAly
description: Code, configuration and experiment scripts of the MEDITA platform: ETL pipeline for Italian public-health open data (Ministero della Salute, AIFA, ISTAT), storage benchmark, schema-matching evaluation, HANK retrieval-augmented chatbot evaluation and the end-to-end statistical use case. The script paper/make_all.py regenerates all experimental tables and figures. The health-news corpus used by HANK is protected by copyright and is not distributed: only per-question scores are included.
